text:
ana: Heads-up: field asked for a low-friction maintenance handshake for private deployments — pause/resume upgrades, audit trail, and a clear rollback command. Quick brainstorm?

devon: Pause/resume token (+ CLI & API) sounds right. should be short-lived and tied to a maintenance window.

mike: Acme wants the operator to approve upgrades from their side. propose `--handshake-token` that both sides exchange before a rollout.

sam.k: we need a dry-run that predicts route changes and an egress cost delta. could sample traffic to validate the prediction.

irene: launch gates: 1) dry-run passed in staging 2) handshake token accepted by both parties 3) rollback tested (CLI + console). MVP can be manual failover, Tier1 adds auto-revert.

andrea: note: customer audit requirement means every route change must be logged and exported to S3/ELK.

deploy-bot: DEPLOY: installer v1.8.1 -> canary (sha: def456)

devon: action items: devon — spec token lifecycle + API; mike — prototype CLI `redwood maintenance pause|resume --token`; sam.k — dry-run telemetry plan; irene — runbook revert steps; ana — outreach to pilot customers.

ana: scheduling 15m sync Fri to lock acceptance criteria. drop short notes in the doc if you can't make it. :calendar:
